description.value: Sorrento's Pizza LTD has been a West Vancouver neighbourhood institution since 1983, serving hand-tossed thin-crust pizza, house-made pasta, and fresh salads. The restaurant offers dine-in, pickup, delivery, and take-and-bake options, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a sit-down meal or food to go. The extensive menu draws on authentic Italian recipes with locally sourced touches like a BC Pizza featuring smoked wild salmon.
